findings.scope: Guided Q01 path requires 10 clicks for 5 tiles (Preview + Confirm each), prices and Cancel clear; consider auto-preparing next preview while retaining explicit Confirm.
Q02 low welfare after ate/drank yes: mission View birds and aviary only moves camera; concrete cause reachable via extra Care then Inspect steps. No human-impact claim.
After arrival the first Care action becomes Return both birds to reserve; edit purpose is buried in surrounding copy. Consider secondary emphasis/clear edit-purpose label.

findings.note: Language role locator matched Options and modal controls; failed before mutation. Scoped actual Settings dialog control instead; not claimed as product defect.

findings.scope: Normal pause disables Inspect/Close animal details and Go to care navigation, although these are read-only UI; this prevents safe exploration of welfare causes while paused.
English Q04 visible text has welfare60 / for30 / Earn20 / least2 spacing errors.
Options exit says Close3Dpreview and entry secondaryOpen3Dpreview; technical wording obscures return/start intent. Help mentions visual settings but omits the implemented sound setting.
PRD requires unaided test notes and corrections. Agent walkthroughs and the owner brief viewing do not supply a first-run unaided human study; do not mark M5-07 complete or ask owner to test now.

desktopResult.note: Agent used visible UI and10x/1x; timing includes tool/analysis delays, not a human usability metric
